evidence.scope: Mobile display-correctness fix, not new design work: app/globals.css carried a leftover, explicitly-labeled work-in-progress rule block ('Mobile foreground approval stage... underlay added only after these rectangles are approved', @media max-width:820px) that shipped uncommitted alongside the approved sourcing-row edit. Being last in the cascade, it silently beat the documented 'Foreground-first process rendering — 2026-09-03' rules in docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md: it set .format-process-plan/.story-origin-process-plan to opacity:0 (hiding the blueprint underlay on every phone/tablet width) and forced the process-field to a 2:3 box, stranding the photo+copy pair in a thin top band over a blank cream rectangle. Fix was a pure deletion of that block — no new selectors, values, or breakpoints added.
evidence.desktop: Loaded http://localhost:3000 at 1280px and inspected the private-dinner (.format-row-1) process row via computed styles: .format-process-field is exactly 2:1 (1162x581), .format-process-plan matches the field with no offset, .format-media/.format-copy sit inside the field at the documented top/left percentages with opacity 1. Matches pre-existing desktop behavior exactly, since the deleted rule was scoped to max-width:820px and never touched desktop.
evidence.mobile: Checked 375px, 360px and 768px widths. After the fix, .format-process-field aspect-ratio returned to the documented .85/1 (tablet)/underlay-visible composition instead of the stray 2/3 box; .format-process-plan opacity returned from 0 to 1 (confirmed both via getComputedStyle and visually in screenshots) for all three event-format rows (Частный ужин, Приватные мероприятия, Мастер-классы) and the MasterChef story-origin row. Screenshots after the fix show photo+copy overlaid on the now-visible blueprint drawing at every width, matching docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md's 'photograph and live copy remain side-by-side rather than stacking' rule. Also checked: no horizontal overflow at 375/360px (document.documentElement.scrollWidth === innerWidth), sourcing rows (Мясо/Рыба/Овощи) and contact/footer render correctly unchanged, and the intentionally screen-reader-only present-day workday heading/list (.present-day-accessible, clip-rect sr-only pattern present at all widths, not a mobile-only regression) was confirmed as pre-existing/intentional rather than a new bug, since the workday-four-step-vertical.png blueprint already carries that information pictorially.
evidence.anti_template: No design decision was made in this session — nothing to run the transplantation/generic-sequence/card tests against as new choices. The change restores rendering to the composition already documented and approved in docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md ('Foreground-first process rendering — 2026-09-03'); it removes dead/conflicting CSS rather than adding any.
evidence.follow_up_2026-09-03: Two further mobile-only fixes layered on top of the above in a separate session, verified live on https://evgenychef.com in a real mobile viewport (375px) with images force-decoded before each screenshot: (1) three row-specific selectors (.format-row-1/2/3.format-row-process .format-copy) still carried position:relative plus dead grid-column/grid-row from a pre-overlay layout iteration; at equal-or-higher specificity than the documented position:absolute rule, relative won the cascade, so the copy block stayed in normal flow and reserved blank space instead of overlaying the art — fixed by deleting the stale position/grid-column/grid-row declarations, leaving z-index only. (2) even with the diagram visible (opacity 1) and the copy correctly absolute, .format-process-field's mobile aspect-ratio (.85/1, later .72/1 duplicate) was far off the blueprint art's native 2:1 ratio, and object-fit:contain on .format-process-plan therefore rendered it as a thin letterboxed strip inside a mostly-blank box — photo and copy visually floated above a cream void rather than reading as collaged onto the drawing, which is what the user flagged directly on production ('картинка и текст должны попадать в фон'). Fixed with an additive @media (max-width:820px) block (placed after all prior mobile rules so it wins ties) setting aspect-ratio:1.4/1 and object-fit:cover on the plan image, closing the gap between the art's ratio and mobile's taller text-friendly box without reverting to the original 2:1 (which was too short for legible mobile copy). Confirmed via getComputedStyle + screenshots for all three event-format rows on production after redeploy; .story-origin (Мясо/Рыба/Овощи map section) is untouched since the new rule is scoped to .format-row-process only.
